headline: Executive order sets U.S. policy on steps to take before and after military strikes to reduce and address civilian casualties.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets official U.S. policy on how the government handles civilian casualties in operations that use force. It covers steps taken before a strike to lower the risk of harming civilians, and steps taken after a strike to address any civilian harm. No summary was provided, so specific details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. military and other agencies that carry out armed operations
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to follow set policies before and after strikes to address civilian casualties.

who_it_affects.group: Civilians in areas where U.S. forces use force
who_it_affects.how: The policy is aimed at reducing harm to them and addressing harm that does occur.
